info.title: LastDB ExeMem Cloud API
info.description: ExeMem Cloud API v3 design. ExeMem/relays are untrusted storage and transport. Acceptance is the local node rule AcceptEntry (see cloud-api.md). Canonical history is signed writer hash chains with a publisher spine. Relay protocol: relay-protocol.md. Closed schemas; no dual paths or fallback.

nodeSignature.description:
Ed25519 over POST
<path>
<protocol|->
<node key>
<device id>
<issued-at>
<nonce>
<body sha256 hex>. Skew ±60s. Companion headers required.
